# Extra GitHub logins that may open pull requests.
#
# Already allowed without an entry here:
# - authors of a previously merged pull request (Contributor)
# - users with admin, maintain, or write access on this repository
# - bots
#
# One login per line. Text after # is a comment. A leading @ is ignored.
# Repository variable PR_AUTHOR_ALLOWLIST is merged with this file
# (commas, spaces, or newlines). Set PR_AUTHOR_GUARD=off to disable the guard.
#
# Push-capable maintainers who are not on the contributor graph.
# Kept here so a failed permission lookup cannot lock them out.
